style: Soft watercolour kawaii illustration in a pearly pastel palette of lilac, blush pink and peach with a gentle white glow, like a children's storybook. Rounded cute shapes, glossy highlights, a few tiny sparkles. One scene, centred, with generous empty margin, on a plain flat very pale lavender background (#F8F3FB). No text, no letters, no numbers, no border, no frame, no cast shadow on the ground.
mascot: The FreeFlow mascot is a round pearly speech-bubble creature with a small rounded tail, an iridescent lilac to blush to peach body, big glossy deep-violet eyes with small white sparkles, pink blush cheeks and a tiny smile.

images.name: hello
images.scene: The mascot waves hello with one tiny arm. A small glowing microphone floats beside it.

images.name: words
images.scene: The mascot reads a small open book with sparkles rising from the pages. Two more little books are stacked beside it.

images.name: snippets
images.scene: The mascot holds a small folded note with a little star sticker on it. A few tiny paper notes float around it.

images.name: modes
images.scene: The mascot holds a little paintbrush next to a soft pastel colour palette with five round dots of colour.

images.name: meetings
images.scene: Two mascots, one lilac and one peach, sit side by side, each with a small empty speech bubble above it, as if chatting. A tiny round clock floats between them.

images.name: files
images.scene: The mascot hugs a cute round cassette tape that has a glowing soft sound wave line across it.

images.name: learning
images.scene: The mascot waters a tiny green sprout growing in a little pastel pot, with sparkles around the sprout.

images.name: sleepy
images.scene: The mascot sleeps peacefully curled up on a small round pillow, eyes closed with a smile, with tiny stars floating above it.
